annotator: Codex source-image review; these are image annotations, not physical point measurements
protocol: Inspect only training episode 0 frame 200. Sample outer mat boundary on straight segments, excluding rounded corners, cable crossings, bowl occlusion and cloth interior. Local grayscale gradients guided half-pixel placement; bottom outer boundary was distinguished visually from the bright stitched line and diffuse shadow. Orthogonal straight-line fits intersect at virtual corners; these intersections are not directly observed physical corner points.
selection: Frame 200 has visible straight sections of all four mat edges. No validation or later-frame scores select annotations or solution.
corner_sigma_note: Diagnostic working uncertainty, not a measured statistical confidence interval. Sensitivity is separately evaluated at 1 and 3 pixels.
side_length_assignment: table.mat.size_xy[0] is assigned across the image (top-left to top-right), [1] along the mat (top-left to bottom-left). This inherits the existing config axis-assignment hypothesis inferred from older images; the operator measured 12 by 16 inches but did not independently register these axes.
